main_body: wooden tea table with teapot and cups on top
top_band: orange border and tan/beige recessed tabletop surface from row 5 to row 9
evidence: The main body of the tea table spans rows 5-15. Rows 5-9 form a clear 5px tall horizontal top surface (tan inner surface framed by an orange-red border, with a teapot and small cups resting on it). Row 9 is the bright front edge of the frame, followed by a darker red front rim (row 10), an inset brown drawer band with gold pulls (row 11), a dark eave/apron shadow (row 12), and legs down to row 15.

style.evidence: The piece uses rich multi-step warm wood ramps (tan, ochre, orange-red, deep red, dark brown) with selective dark material outlines rather than black, subtle grain variation on the tabletop, shaded teapot and cups, and crisp structural detailing matching the Beodeul reference standard.
